intro_html: A big pot of hearty, saucy bolognese over high-protein penne, made lean with ground turkey. This is the weeknight pasta that tastes like Sunday, holds up beautifully in the fridge, and keeps you full without a food coma. Simple ingredients, big comfort, about $3.55 a bowl (at everyday cost).
cost_closing_html: About $3.55 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a from-scratch bolognese. Swap in ground beef if it is cheaper that week, the macros barely move.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 418 calories and 34 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Comfort-food dinners for about $3.55 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Turkey or beef, whichever is on sale. Both work here. Buy the cheaper one and freeze extra in one-pound packs.
Double the sauce, freeze half. The sauce freezes great, so a little extra effort now buys you a head start on next week.
Store-brand parmesan is a fraction of the name brand and disappears into the sauce anyway.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Boil the penne to al dente per the box, then drain.
Brown the ground turkey in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Pour in the pasta sauce and simmer 10 minutes to let it thicken into a bolognese.
Add the drained penne and stir to coat, then fold in the parmesan off the heat.
